galaxy_predictions.los_rule: v_los-v_sys=v_c(R) sin(i_phot) cos(theta_disk); no kinematic orientation or inclination refit
galaxy_predictions.systematic_use: report sensitivity only; do not choose a value per galaxy

cluster_predictions.field: central fixed 900 kpc square, mass-conservative anti-aliased resampling; each component lifted with sech-squared depth equal to its own projected RMS radius
cluster_predictions.deflection: store physical alpha for Dds/Ds=1; multiply by the independently measured source-redshift distance ratio after unsealing
cluster_predictions.mass_systematics: use the already registered common low/high stellar and gas maps; report only and never select per cluster
cluster_predictions.ordinary_primary_nuisance: one source-plane position per family only; no center shift, external shear, ellipticity, rotation, radial amplitude, mass sheet, or gravity parameter

unlock_rule: Only if every P0708 gate passes: commit and push this protocol, the resolved parameter hash, every prediction hash, and an unlock manifest before parsing any sealed target payload.
claim_boundary: P0708 uses open baryonic inputs only and computes no target score.
AQUAL and QUMOND photon deflections are explicitly nonrelativistic diagnostics.
The cluster line-of-sight lift is a fixed measurement model, not a gravity parameter.
Passing P0708 authorizes one external evaluation; it does not establish the theory.
